                        November 17 2025
                     GBOS Regular Meeting
                              Minutes Final
         7:00 p.m. via Microsoft Teams & Girdwood Community Room

This hybrid meeting is taking place via Microsoft Teams & at the Girdwood Community Room, 250 Egloff Rd:
The Girdwood Board of Supervisors is subject to the Alaska Open Meetings Act as found in Alaska Statute 44.62.310
and Anchorage Municipal Code1.25 - Public Meetings.
The Girdwood Board of Supervisors operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Call to Order 7:00 p.m. Mike Edgington, Co-Chair

Land Acknowledgement: The Girdwood Board of Supervisors acknowledges the indigenous peoples of Alaska, whose land we
reside on. The community of Girdwood, situated between the areas known to be Dena'ina and Alutiiq homeland, respects the people
who were stewards of this land for generations. We commit to the continued stewardship of this land and are grateful to be part of a
wider community that seeks to maintain a sustainable use of Girdwood Valley for present and future peoples.

Roll Call Attending are Briana Sullivan (BS), Brian Burnett (BB), Jennifer Wingard (JW), Kellie Okonek (KO), Mike
Edgington (ME)

6. GBOS Resolution on the 50th Anniversary of MOA Unification (Burnett/Edgington)

    Motion:

    Motion carries by Assent

7.  Discuss increase in permit fees for Girdwood parks and recreation resources (Burnett)

    Motion:
   GBOS moves to postpone this to December Regular Meeting
    Motion by BB/2nd KO
    Motion carries by Assent

8.  Agenda Item LUC 2510-04: Consider GBOS input to HLB Annual work program and 5 year management plan. Public comment
    period ends 11/21/25 2026_HLBWorkPlan_DRAFT_20250930_PublicReview.pdf (Wingard)
    Item was discussed in work session, at that time GBOS tentatively scheduled Special Meeting

    Motion:
   GBOS moves to postpone this discussion to Special Meeting on WED Nov 19 at 10AM.
    Motion by JW/2nd BS
    Motion carries by Assent

9.  Agenda Item LUC 2407-04 (A): Review GBOS action related to AO2025-91 Municipal STR Tax proposal. (Wingard/Burnett)
    Group discusses that GBOS passed Resolution 2025-18 in Support of STR tax with amendment to allocate funds within the zip
    code they are received at their meeting on Oct 20. On Oct 21 Assembly postponed their vote to Nov 18. It may still be further
    postponed. BB shares written explanation to LUC, which will be provided at the LUC December meeting.

    Motion:
   GBOS moves to request LUC consider voting on GBOS resolution 2025-18 at their December 2025 Regular Meeting.
    Motion by BB/2nd BS
    Motion carries by Assent

   Agenda Item LUC 2407-04 (B): MOA proposed STR Registration AO 2025-115 (Edgington/Wingard)
    This ordinance for STR registration may go forward at Assembly tomorrow.

    Motion:
   GBOS moves Resolution of Support for Registration ordinance RE: AO 2025-115.
    Motion by BS/2nd BB
   Amendments
   GBOS removes reference to S-1 amendment and adds language to be determined regarding public access to zip code information
     collected through registration to track STR activity.
    Motion by BS/2nd BB
   Amended motion:
   GBOS moves to approve amended resolution of support for STR Registration.
    Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

10. Agenda Item LUC 2510-05: Holtan Hills Development
    A) Discussion and formation of a request regarding street lights/dark night considerations within the on-site Holtan Hills Subdivision
     https://darksky.org/resources/what-is-light-pollution/effects/safety/ (Wingard)
   JW clarifies that action is needed sooner than the Conditional Use for Planned Unit Development as this relates to code regarding
     street lights. This item does not relate to home lighting. She provides draft language for Resolution of Support.

    Motion:
   GBOS moves to approve draft language regarding dark sky strategy as presented.
    Motion by KO/2nd JW
    Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote.

   As language is rough draft, and there is some time to amend, item will be shared with GBOS members prior to signing for possible
    reconsideration vote.

    B) Conditional Use for Planned Use Development (Edgington)
                                                                                         3

Information was received today for Conditional Use for Planned Use Development. Hearing is in early January, comments are
    requested by Dec 15. Item will be on GHEC and LUC agendas in December.
   ME and JW will attend both meetings and draft comments for consideration at Dec 15 GBOS meeting.

Motion: GBOS moves to have BB assume chair for the next topic.      Motion by ME/JW        Assent

11. Agenda Item LUC 2510-06: Federation of Community Councils
    Delegate clarification for FCC (Wingard)
   JW has requested email from FCC regarding appointment of ME to FCC in 2021. This request has not been complied with as FCC
    states that a motion from GBOS is required. This evening, ME has provided copies of that email string, from his own records.
    Documents are in the meeting packet revised just prior to this meeting, along with minutes from LUC discussions.

    Motion:
   GBOS requests that FCC share information with GBOS members in the future and open communication channels with members of
    the Girdwood Board of Supervisors.
    Motion by KO/2nd JW
    Motion carries 4-1 (BS dissenting) in roll call vote

    Motion:
   GBOS moves to adopt the following language from LUC: Whereas there is no evidence of an official appointment or election of an
   FCC delegate from Girdwood since 2020, the Girdwood Land Use Committee agrees that:

     1.  Girdwood does not have a current delegate to the Federation of Community Councils, and
     2.  Girdwood has not had an FCC delegate since January, 2021.
    Motion by JW/2nd KO

Motion: GBOS moves to extend the meeting to 10:30PM.              Motion by KO/ME        Assent

   Amendment:
  GBOS amends to LUC language as follows:
   Remove Whereas there is no evidence of an official appointment or election of an FCC delegate from Girdwood since 2020, the
   Girdwood Land Use Committee agrees that:
   Replace #2 LUC Supervisor should be appointed to serve as the Delegate to the FCC
   Amendment to motion by ME/2nd BS
   Motion carries 3-2 (JW and KO dissenting) in roll call vote

  Amended motion:
  GBOS moves that:
   Girdwood does not have a current delegate to the Federation of Community Councils, and
  FCC Delegate should be the GBOS Land Use Supervisor
   Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote.

Motion: GBOS moves to extend the meeting to 10:33PM              Motion by JW/ME        Assent
Chair returns to ME
